mission: Market Value plan A (owner decision 2026-10-28, after the nightly publisher stopped on 2026-10-26: 'persisted publication history conflicts with deterministic replay: missing=64 unexpected=0 mismatched=3840'). Publication verified every published day against ONE digest of today's catalogue, so the 2026-10-26 catalogue imports (about 212 prints, new coded release EB-05) made all history mismatch. Each published day is now verified against the membership frozen with it (new append-only ledger, additive migration 001d92ba8eb9); new days are published with today's membership, frozen in the same transaction; rankings use each day's frozen basket. Formulas, thresholds, gates and the methodology version are unchanged and no published row is rewritten; the owner chose this behaviour (new prints count from the day they arrive; a release's chain restarts only when its own prints change), as docs/market_value.md already required ('future published points must freeze their own membership revision'). The pre-ledger membership is frozen by the new owner-approved market-value-freeze-legacy runbook only when it hashes exactly to the stored digest. Order after merge: owner runs apply-migration (dry run, apply), then market-value-freeze-legacy (dry run, apply); the next 20:00Z run publishes the waiting days. The fleet keeps revision 7a52e9b48e8a until apply-migration runs; a fleet PR then records 001d92ba8eb9.

impacts.reason: Three new empty append-only tables (memberships, membership prints, membership releases) with FKs to card_prints and release_products; nothing existing changes. Applied after merge by the owner-approved apply-migration runbook. Models not imported by app.models, so no collector loads them.

Frozen membership read/freeze/rebuild; per-date replay loader and draft builder (legacy builder unchanged, proven equal for a single membership); publisher replays each day with its own membership and freezes today's before new points; recovery writer freezes its membership and refuses without the ledger; rankings rank each day with its own frozen basket (typed 503 when a point names no frozen membership).

market-value-freeze-legacy ops-write runbook (dry run plan + SHA; apply writes about 3,600 membership rows only, under the writer job-lock row; not collector-affecting); apply-migration allowlists 001d92ba8eb9 on 7a52e9b48e8a; ops-write choice list. No secret, gate, permission or timeout change.

Import between published days; new coded release; release whose prints change; missing or tampered ledger; legacy rebuild exact-digest only; freeze runbook gate; movers across a membership change; migration schema, constraints and downgrade; legacy/frozen builder equivalence.
Methodology ledger, forward publication steps, runbooks.

routes: /market-value movers and most-valuable read the frozen membership; no source route
dependencies: then apply-migration 001d92ba8eb9 (owner), market-value-freeze-legacy (owner), fleet revision PR
impact.deployment_impact: API, market-index-snapshot and official-images-mirror rebuild from Git (API image). Until the migration and legacy freeze run, market value publication keeps refusing (as it does today) and rankings return a typed 503 (as today). No collector release.

recovery.procedure: Native revert PR with its own mission file; the membership tables are additive and can stay (downgrade only by a separate decision). Points published with frozen memberships stay valid history.
recovery.trigger: Publication or rankings refuse after the migration and legacy freeze, or the freeze dry run cannot rebuild the legacy membership exactly.
recovery.backup: Railway Postgres backup under 24 h (required by apply-migration).

verification.observation_window: apply-migration and freeze runs; the next 20:00Z market-index-snapshot run publishes 10-26 onward (Deploy Logs: market_value.status succeeded); rankings 200.
